name: Squire Lollop, Lord of the Manor
text: Start of Turn: Hedgerow folk touching this, except your biggest, gain a tenth of its stats.
golden_text: Start of Turn: Hedgerow folk touching this, except your biggest, gain a fifth of its stats.

source.note: Pass 3; amended tribe gates and provisional paper B/C rates in content/pass3/rates.json.

details: Biggest means Attack plus Health; ties use reading order. Read once before gains. Shares round down and are permanent. Only touching Hedgerow folk gain; your biggest never gains.
golden_details: Biggest means Attack plus Health; ties use reading order. Read once before gains. Shares round down and are permanent. Only touching Hedgerow folk gain; your biggest never gains.
